sam: Quick follow-up from PM-2026-083 — summarizing owners and short ETAs. Root cause: LB reconcile thrash + DNS TTL shadowing + TLS handshake retries. Posting action list.

ops-bot: Postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/PM-2026-083 :spiral_note_pad: 

akash: I'll take DNS invalidation. Plan: reduce canary TTL to 10s and emit invalidation events. ETA: 2026-07-02 18:00 UTC.

leo: I'll own the reconcile guardrail. Plan: add a version check and short cooldown after 3 rapid applies. ETA: 2026-07-02 16:00 UTC.

maria: I'll add alerts and a runbook snippet. Composite alert: (route_apply_retries>4 OR dns_invalidation_failures>8 OR edge_tls_handshake_retry spike) => page networking-sre. ETA: 2026-07-02 20:00 UTC.

sam: Action list: akash (DNS) ETA 18:00, leo (reconcile) ETA 16:00, maria (alerts) ETA 20:00. I'll convert to tickets and run probes after deploys.

akash: Update 2026-07-02 17:30 UTC: TTL change pushed to canary; invalidation events firing, shadow_count down ~80%.

leo: Update 2026-07-02 16:45 UTC: version-check merged to canary; cooldown enabled. Rolling to canary now.

maria: Update 2026-07-02 20:10 UTC: alerts created and smoke-tested. Runbook snippet added to PM-2026-083.

sam: Running verification probes now across us-east/us-west/eu. Will post CSV to the postmortem. If stable, closing immediate follow-ups and moving longer-term items to grooming.
